baseline.roster: the proposing device and one peer are members and the mesh is not halted
baseline.allowance: fresh: a peer was in contact inside the freshness window and the default budget policy applies
baseline.model: one provider that is not PHI-approved, scripted to propose the call once and then reply

operations.raise_stop: an owner stop with the given counter
operations.resume: an owner resume naming the given counter
operations.remove_device: the proposing device leaves the roster
operations.hard_flag: the host flags the tool as a hard security risk
operations.change_tool_def: the definition the tool serves changes
operations.narrow_policy: an owner narrowing rule for the key agent/tool/scope
operations.solo_allowance: no peer contact inside the freshness window
operations.spend_allowance: the dimension is spent through the device's own allowance holder
operations.label_context: owner_message relabels the owner message; outward_read runs the named outward-read tool first so its untrusted result is in context

timing.before_turn: the default: applied before the turn starts
timing.model_call: applied while the model request that proposes the call is in flight
timing.awaiting_consent: applied after the consent prompt appears and before the owner answers

consent.none: if a prompt appears, the owner declines it
consent.valid: the owner approves and the presence key signs this action
consent.wrong_action: the owner approves and the presence key signs a consent for a different action digest

expect.dispatched: calls of the named tool that reached its runner
expect.outcome: allow when it ran; consent with code consent.required and the prompt reasons when a prompt was not validly approved; otherwise refuse with the normalized code
expect.gate: the gate number of the pure decision over state; hosts that do not journal it check it only through state
expect.prompt: the consent prompt for the call and its ordered reasons, or null when none may appear
expect.journal_status: status of the call's journaled result, or null when the call was never proposed
expect.journal_code: raw code of the call journaled result, before normalized outcome comparison

skip.kernel: The engine derives private access from a private running label or any listed local tool, so a private context that is also untrusted always has private access and adds rule_of_two. untrusted-influence-with-private-access-asks covers the reachable state.

cases.name: untrusted-influence-with-private-access-asks
cases.note: The source state with private access set, which is how a private chat with local tools reaches it.

skip.kernel: A model request is not a tool call: policy rules name an agent, tool and scope, and the model flow check runs before any tool is proposed, so no policy rule can apply to a model-target effect.

cases.name: flow-refusal-outranks-consent
cases.note: The consent rule names the tool the model would propose. A host refuses the model request before that tool is evaluated, so this checks the outcome, not the order of a policy step.

cases.name: consent-for-another-action-does-not-dispatch
cases.note: The presence signature is valid but covers a different action digest, so the call keeps its consent outcome.
